# Environment and `site.toml`

<!-- Generated by `partifactory config docs` from crates/pf-config. Do not edit by hand; CI (`ci/env-docs.sh`) fails if this file differs from the generated copy. -->

partifactory reads its config from `site.toml` (path `PF_SITE_TOML`, default `/data/site.toml`). Every key below can also be set as an environment variable, `PF_<SECTION>_<KEY>`, and **the environment wins**. A missing `site.toml` is an empty config. Unknown sections and keys are rejected, with a suggestion.

**Secrets never go in `site.toml`.** Each comes from its variable or from `<VAR>_FILE`, a path to a file holding it (how Docker and compose secrets mount). One trailing newline in the file is trimmed, an empty file counts as missing, and setting both the variable and its `_FILE` is an error.

Run `partifactory config check` to load the config exactly as `serve` would. It prints one JSON line per finding (`event="config.check"`) and exits 2 on any error.

**Keep an offline copy** of `site.toml`, the admin pin and the export age identity in the password manager. Without them, nothing else is recoverable (§5c).

## Secrets

| Variable | Required | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PF_SESSION_KEY` / `PF_SESSION_KEY_FILE` | yes | Signs workspace session cookies. Required. |
| `PF_CAP_HMAC_KEY` / `PF_CAP_HMAC_KEY_FILE` | yes | Signs part capabilities. Required. |
| `PF_METRICS_TOKEN` / `PF_METRICS_TOKEN_FILE` | yes | Bearer token for `/metrics`. Required. |
| `PF_IDP_CLIENT_SECRET` / `PF_IDP_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE` | see note | The OIDC client secret. Required when `[idp]` is set. |
| `PF_RUNNER_KEY` / `PF_RUNNER_KEY_FILE` | see note | Authenticates the backend runner. Required when `backends.enabled`. |
| `PF_DNS_API_TOKEN` / `PF_DNS_API_TOKEN_FILE` | see note | Optional: the DNS adapter's API token. |
| `PF_TUNNEL_TOKEN` / `PF_TUNNEL_TOKEN_FILE` | see note | Optional: the tunnel connector token. |
| `PF_IDP_PROVISIONER_TOKEN` / `PF_IDP_PROVISIONER_TOKEN_FILE` | see note | Optional: the IdP provisioner's API token. |
| `PF_ALERTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` / `PF_ALERTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET_FILE` | see note | Optional: signs ops-alert webhooks. |
| `PF_CDN_ANALYTICS_TOKEN` / `PF_CDN_ANALYTICS_TOKEN_FILE` | see note | Optional: reads CDN analytics for Insights. |

## `site.toml` keys

| Key | Env | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `admin.subject` | `PF_ADMIN_SUBJECT` | string | (unset) | The one admin, as `<issuer>#<sub>` or the IdP `sub`. |
| `advisories.enabled` | `PF_ADVISORIES_ENABLED` | bool | `true` | Record library lists per build and (after Slice 1) match them against advisories. |
| `alerts.webhook_url` | `PF_ALERTS_WEBHOOK_URL` | string | (unset) | Where ops alerts are POSTed (after Slice 1). Signed with `PF_ALERTS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. |
| `backends.enabled` | `PF_BACKENDS_ENABLED` | bool | `false` | Turn on the backend runner. Requires `PF_RUNNER_KEY`. |
| `backup.age_recipient` | `PF_BACKUP_AGE_RECIPIENT` | string | (unset) | Optional age public key; exports are encrypted to it. Not a secret. |
| `backup.export_dir` | `PF_BACKUP_EXPORT_DIR` | string | `"/data/exports"` | Where scheduled exports are written. |
| `backup.export_keep` | `PF_BACKUP_EXPORT_KEEP` | integer | `7` | How many scheduled exports to keep. |
| `backup.export_schedule` | `PF_BACKUP_EXPORT_SCHEDULE` | string | `"nightly"` | `nightly`, or `off` (a protection switched off: needs `[unsafe] nightly_export = "off"`). |
| `backup.host_snapshots` | `PF_BACKUP_HOST_SNAPSHOTS` | string | `"unknown"` | Whether the host snapshots `/data` (`on`, `off` or `unknown`); shown on Health. |
| `deploy.host` | `PF_DEPLOY_HOST` | string | (unset) | Where `partifactory deploy` runs compose (an SSH target). |
| `disk.budget_percent` | `PF_DISK_BUDGET_PERCENT` | integer | `80` | The share of the volume partifactory may use. `100` switches the budget off and needs `[unsafe] disk_budget = "off"`. |
| `disk.stores.audit` | `PF_DISK_STORES_AUDIT` | integer | `268435456` | Byte cap for audit; bounded from 1 KiB to eight times its safe default. |
| `disk.stores.blobs` | `PF_DISK_STORES_BLOBS` | integer | `21474836480` | Byte cap for blobs; bounded from 1 KiB to eight times its safe default. |
| `disk.stores.build_logs` | `PF_DISK_STORES_BUILD_LOGS` | integer | `536870912` | Byte cap for build logs; bounded from 1 KiB to eight times its safe default. |
| `disk.stores.data_docs` | `PF_DISK_STORES_DATA_DOCS` | integer | `21474836480` | Byte cap for data docs; bounded from 1 KiB to eight times its safe default. |
| `disk.stores.data_snapshots` | `PF_DISK_STORES_DATA_SNAPSHOTS` | integer | `2147483648` | Byte cap for data snapshots; bounded from 1 KiB to eight times its safe default. |
| `disk.stores.events` | `PF_DISK_STORES_EVENTS` | integer | `134217728` | Byte cap for events; bounded from 1 KiB to eight times its safe default. |
| `disk.stores.exports` | `PF_DISK_STORES_EXPORTS` | integer | `8589934592` | Byte cap for scheduled exports; bounded from 1 KiB to eight times its safe default. |
| `disk.stores.idempotency` | `PF_DISK_STORES_IDEMPOTENCY` | integer | `134217728` | Byte cap for idempotency; bounded from 1 KiB to eight times its safe default. |
| `disk.stores.mirror_cache` | `PF_DISK_STORES_MIRROR_CACHE` | integer | `5368709120` | Byte cap for mirror cache; bounded from 1 KiB to eight times its safe default. |
| `disk.stores.previews` | `PF_DISK_STORES_PREVIEWS` | integer | `2147483648` | Byte cap for previews; bounded from 1 KiB to eight times its safe default. |
| `disk.stores.quota_hits` | `PF_DISK_STORES_QUOTA_HITS` | integer | `16777216` | Byte cap for quota hits; bounded from 1 KiB to eight times its safe default. |
| `disk.stores.runtime_errors` | `PF_DISK_STORES_RUNTIME_ERRORS` | integer | `134217728` | Byte cap for runtime errors; bounded from 1 KiB to eight times its safe default. |
| `disk.stores.shared_blobs` | `PF_DISK_STORES_SHARED_BLOBS` | integer | `5368709120` | Byte cap for shared blobs; bounded from 1 KiB to eight times its safe default. |
| `dns.cloudflare.account_id` | `PF_DNS_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID` | string | (unset) | Cloudflare adapter: account id. |
| `dns.cloudflare.plan` | `PF_DNS_CLOUDFLARE_PLAN` | string | (unset) | Cloudflare adapter: the zone's plan (`free`, `pro`, …), which decides the health check. |
| `dns.cloudflare.tunnel_name` | `PF_DNS_CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_NAME` | string | (unset) | Cloudflare adapter: the tunnel's name. |
| `dns.cloudflare.zone_id` | `PF_DNS_CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID` | string | (unset) | Cloudflare adapter: zone id. |
| `dns.provider` | `PF_DNS_PROVIDER` | string | `"manual"` | `manual` (prints the records to create) or `cloudflare` (the adapter, after Slice 1). |
| `domain.apex` | `PF_DOMAIN_APEX` | string | (unset) | The apex every hostname hangs off, e.g. `example.com`. Required (set it here or as `PF_DOMAIN_APEX`). |
| `domain.part_suffix` | `PF_DOMAIN_PART_SUFFIX` | string | `"-part"` | Appended to a part's name to make its host label: `pixel` + `-part` gives `pixel-part.<apex>`. |
| `domain.workspace_host` | `PF_DOMAIN_WORKSPACE_HOST` | string | `"parts"` | The workspace's label under the apex: `parts` gives `parts.<apex>`. |
| `embed.frame_ancestors` | `PF_EMBED_FRAME_ANCESTORS` | list (comma-separated in env) | `[]` | Origins allowed to frame the workspace (the family hub, for example). |
| `idp.audience_group` | `PF_IDP_AUDIENCE_GROUP` | string | (unset) | Optional: only members of this group may sign in. |
| `idp.client_id` | `PF_IDP_CLIENT_ID` | string | (unset) | The OIDC client id. |
| `idp.groups_claim` | `PF_IDP_GROUPS_CLAIM` | string | `"groups"` | The ID-token claim that carries group names. |
| `idp.issuer` | `PF_IDP_ISSUER` | string | (unset) | The OIDC issuer URL. Setting it turns on sign-in and requires `PF_IDP_CLIENT_SECRET`. |
| `idp.provisioner.base_url` | `PF_IDP_PROVISIONER_BASE_URL` | string | (unset) | Provisioner adapter: the IdP's base URL. |
| `idp.provisioner.flows` | `PF_IDP_PROVISIONER_FLOWS` | table (PF_<TABLE>_<NAME> in env) | `{}` | Provisioner adapter: flow names by purpose (free-form table). |
| `idp.provisioner.kind` | `PF_IDP_PROVISIONER_KIND` | string | `"none"` | `none` or `authentik` (the provisioner adapter, after Slice 1). |
| `idp.provisioner.tier` | `PF_IDP_PROVISIONER_TIER` | string | (unset) | Provisioner adapter: the tier the provisioner gate recorded. |
| `ingress.client_ip_header` | `PF_INGRESS_CLIENT_IP_HEADER` | string | `"X-Forwarded-For"` | The header the proxy puts the client IP in. Read only from `trusted_proxies`. |
| `ingress.kind` | `PF_INGRESS_KIND` | string | `"proxy"` | How traffic arrives: `proxy` (any reverse proxy meeting the ingress contract), `cloudflare-tunnel` or `acme`. |
| `ingress.rate_limits` | `PF_INGRESS_RATE_LIMITS` | bool | `true` | The rate-limit layer. `false` switches it off and needs `[unsafe] rate_limits = "off"`. |
| `ingress.request_id_header` | `PF_INGRESS_REQUEST_ID_HEADER` | string | `"X-Request-Id"` | The request-id header passed through from the proxy, or minted when absent. |
| `ingress.trusted_proxies` | `PF_INGRESS_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | list (comma-separated in env) | `[]` | CIDRs whose `client_ip_header` and `request_id_header` are believed. |
| `mirror.allowlist` | `PF_MIRROR_ALLOWLIST` | list (comma-separated in env) | `["cdnjs.cloudflare.com", "cdn.jsdelivr.net", "unpkg.com", "esm.sh", "fonts.googleapis.com", "fonts.gstatic.com"]` | CDN hosts that builds may mirror libraries from. |
| `mirror.test_resolve` | `PF_MIRROR_TEST_RESOLVE` | table (PF_<TABLE>_<NAME> in env) | `{}` | Dev-only exact CDN hostname to socket-address overrides for the test harness. Refused by a production binary. |
| `names.reserved` | `PF_NAMES_RESERVED` | list (comma-separated in env) | `[]` | Part names nobody may take. |
| `render.enabled` | `PF_RENDER_ENABLED` | bool | `false` | Turn on the render sidecar for `part_check`. |
| `unsafe` | `PF_UNSAFE` | table (PF_<TABLE>_<NAME> in env) | `{}` | Protections deliberately switched off, as `<name> = "off"`. Each one is reported as a warning. |
| `webhooks.enabled` | `PF_WEBHOOKS_ENABLED` | bool | `false` | Signed event webhooks for agents (after Slice 1; inert until then). |

## Runtime and compose settings

These select listeners, files and optional deployment services; they are not site keys.

| Variable | Default / purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `PF_DATA_DIR` | `/data`, the only durable application state. |
| `PF_LISTEN_WORKSPACE` | `0.0.0.0:8080`, proxy network only. |
| `PF_LISTEN_CONTENT` | `0.0.0.0:8081`, proxy network only. |
| `PF_LISTEN_OPS` | `0.0.0.0:9090`, publish to loopback only. |
| `PF_RENDER_PUBLIC_DIR` | `/data/render-public`, public renderer certificate and SPKI only. |
| `PF_LISTEN_RENDER` | `0.0.0.0:443`, internal render TLS listener. Compose uses `8443`. |
| `PF_RENDER_CDP` | `http://partifactory-render:9222`, internal CDP endpoint. |
| `PF_RENDER_CONTROL` | `http://partifactory-render:9223`, internal browser controller. |
| `PF_IMAGE` | Required OCI image including `@sha256:…`; no floating tags. |
| `PF_SITE_CONFIG` | Required host path to the offline site.toml mounted read-only. |
| `PF_OPS_PORT` | `9090`, loopback host ops port. |
| `PF_HTTPS_BIND` | `127.0.0.1`, optional proxy bind address. |
| `PF_HTTPS_PORT` | `8443`, optional proxy HTTPS host port. |
| `PF_UPSTREAM_WORKSPACE` | `partifactory:8080`, proxy upstream. |
| `PF_UPSTREAM_CONTENT` | `partifactory:8081`, proxy upstream. |
| `PF_TLS_CERT` / `PF_TLS_KEY` | Host paths to the optional proxy's wildcard TLS files. |
| `PF_APEX` / `PF_WORKSPACE_LABEL` | Derived from domain config by compose for Caddy. |
| `PF_RENDER_APEX` / `PF_RENDER_GATEWAY` | Derived by compose for the isolated renderer. |
| `PF_LOG` | `info`, structured log filter. |

## Protections that need `[unsafe]`

Switching one of these off fails `config check` unless `[unsafe] <name> = "off"` is set too, and a set `[unsafe]` key is reported as a warning (§5h).

| Name | Switched off by |
| --- | --- |
| `secure_headers` | `secure_headers` |
| `quotas` | `quotas` |
| `ingress_tls` | `ingress_tls` |
| `log_redaction` | `log_redaction` |
| `retention_caps` | `retention_caps` |
| `nightly_export` | `backup.export_schedule` |
| `rate_limits` | `ingress.rate_limits` |
| `disk_budget` | `disk.budget_percent` |
